"I had to spectate double during this match, so my recollection is rather dim. Also, the match was very one-sided, so I did not feel it necessary to brief on the few details that emerged from it. As I remember it, FF quite quickly took the upper hand in this game, forcing W into the low-rl area. FF then capitalized on the quads, keeping the tele and high-rl areas throughout the game. There wasn't much lacking from FF's play here today ... all I can say is GG to FF. I also noticed that Pietro did one of the special jumps to GL from the bigroom floor =] , was it because I teased him about that when they practised against tVS the other day?" -Ego === DM3 === FF: 230 - W: 44
